	# scope:number - the number of IGs that would join this party before the root IG
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
				}
			}

				desc = "ztrpol_party_from_green"
			}

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes

					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_green
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "ztrpol_party_leader_powerful"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_ambientalist }
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "ztrpol_party_from_ig_extreme_ambientalist"
			}
		}

			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "ztrpol_party_from_ig_moderate_ambientalist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "ztrpol_party_from_ig_neg_ambientalist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1
				desc = "ztrpol_party_natural_base"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
	}
}
